! Title: Fixture untrusted list
! Network and cosmetic rules survive the gate.
||ads.untrusted.example^$third-party
untrusted.example##.ad
! Ordinary scriptlets survive: the body ships inside the app.
untrusted.example#%#//scriptlet('set-constant', 'adblock', 'false')
! A trusted-* scriptlet does not.
untrusted.example#%#//scriptlet('trusted-set-cookie', 'consent', 'yes')
! Raw JavaScript does not.
untrusted.example#%#window.canRunAds = true;
! A uBO trusted-* alias does not.
untrusted.example##+js(trusted-click-element, .accept)
! Stripped modifiers.
||untrusted.example^$replace=/a/b/
||untrusted.example^$jsinject
||untrusted.example^$removeheader=link
||untrusted.example^$stealth
